sets.title: Passive Type
sets.description: Identify and choose the correct passive construction
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите и выберите правильную пассивную конструкцию

items.prompt: Эта книга _____ многими людьми. (This book is read by many people.)
items.promptEnglish: This book is read by many people. (ongoing, general)
items.explanation: Читается: reflexive passive (-ся). Ongoing/habitual: the book IS read (by many).

items.prompt: Письмо _____. Можно его отправить. (The letter is written. We can send it.)
items.promptEnglish: The letter is written (finished). We can send it.
items.explanation: Написано: short passive participle (neuter). The letter IS written (result).

items.prompt: Дом был _____ в прошлом веке. (The house was built last century.)
items.promptEnglish: The house was built in the last century.
items.hint: Completed past action = был + short passive participle.
items.explanation: Был построен: passive participle with был for past. The house WAS built (completed).
Говорится: reflexive passive. A general statement about what happens here.

items.prompt: Все билеты _____. (All tickets are sold out.)
items.explanation: Проданы: short passive participle (plural). All tickets ARE sold (result).

items.prompt: Этот роман _____ Толстым. (This novel was written by Tolstoy.)
items.promptEnglish: This novel was written by Tolstoy.
items.explanation: Написан Толстым: short participle + instrumental for agent (by Tolstoy).

minimalPairs.context: Книги _____ в этом магазине. (Books are sold here - general fact.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Books are sold in this store. (ongoing, habitual)
minimalPairs.explanation: Продаются: -ся passive (ongoing). Books are generally sold here.

minimalPairs.context: Все книги _____. (All books have been sold - none left.)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: All books are sold out. (completed result)
minimalPairs.explanation: Проданы: short participle (result). The selling is done, none remain.

minimalPairs.context: Дом _____. (The house is being built - construction ongoing.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Строится: -ся passive (process). Construction is in progress.

minimalPairs.context: Дом _____. (The house is built - ready to move in.)
minimalPairs.explanation: Построен: short participle (result). Construction is finished.

sets.title: Transform and Translate
sets.description: Convert active to passive and translate
sets.descriptionRussian: Преобразуйте из действительного залога в страдательный и переведите

translation.hint: General passive = -ся form. No specific agent.
translation.explanation: Говорится: reflexive passive for general statements.
Отправлено: short passive participle (neuter). Result state.

translation.prompt: The house was built by my grandfather.
translation.hint: Past result = был + short participle. Agent in instrumental.
translation.explanation: Был построен: past passive. Моим дедушкой: instrumental agent.

translation.prompt: These products are sold in every store.
translation.answer: Эти продукты продаются в каждом магазине.
translation.explanation: Продаются: -ся passive (plural, ongoing). Sold in general.

blanks: Музей _____ каждый день в десять утра. (The museum opens every day at ten.)
Работа _____. Можно отдыхать. (The work is done. We can rest.)
Этот фильм _____ известным режиссёром. (This film was directed by a famous director.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: -ся passive (habitual) vs short participle (result) vs participle + agent
explanations: Сделана: short participle (fem). The work is done.
Снят режиссёром: short participle (masc) + instrumental agent.

errorCorrection.hint: Agent in passive = instrumental. Толстой -> Толстым.
errorCorrection.explanation: Instrumental of Толстой is Толстым. Agent always takes instrumental in passive.

errorCorrection.hint: Short participle agrees with subject. Работа is feminine = сделана.
errorCorrection.explanation: Работа (fem) -> сделана (fem). Short participles agree in gender/number.

errorCorrection.hint: The store doesn't open something - it IS opened. Passive needs -ся.
errorCorrection.explanation: Открывается: the store opens (passive/reflexive). Without -ся it means 'opens something.'
Книги (plural) -> проданы (plural). Short participle must agree in number.

sets.title: Mixed Challenge
sets.description: All passive constructions mixed with active for contrast
sets.descriptionRussian: Все пассивные конструкции вместе с активными для сравнения

items.hint: Passive = subject receives action. Short participle + instrumental agent.
items.explanation: Ужин приготовлен мамой: the dinner (subject) was prepared by mom (agent). Passive.

items.prompt: В этом ресторане _____ итальянские блюда. (Italian dishes are served at this restaurant.)
items.promptEnglish: Italian dishes are served at this restaurant. (general/ongoing)
items.explanation: Подаются: -ся passive (habitual). Italian dishes are generally served here.

items.prompt: Задание _____ вовремя. (The assignment was submitted on time.)
items.promptEnglish: The assignment was submitted on time. (result)
items.explanation: Сдано: short participle (neuter). The assignment IS submitted (completed result).

items.prompt: Эта песня часто _____ на радио. (This song is often played on the radio.)
items.promptEnglish: This song is often played on the radio. (habitual)
items.explanation: Исполняется: -ся passive (habitual). The song IS played regularly.

items.prompt: Все документы _____ и отправлены. (All documents are signed and sent.)
items.promptEnglish: All documents have been signed and sent.
items.explanation: Подписаны: short participle (plural). Both signed and sent (results).

patternRecognition.question: What is the key difference?
options: First = process (being built now, -ся); second = result (built, finished, participle)
patternRecognition.answer: First = process (being built now, -ся); second = result (built, finished, participle)
patternRecognition.explanation: -Ся = ongoing process (under construction). Short participle = completed result (built).

patternRecognition.sentence: Роман написан Пушкиным. (by Pushkin) / Роман написан на русском языке. (in Russian)
patternRecognition.question: What role does the instrumental play in each?
options: Both mark the agent (who did it)
First = agent (by Pushkin); second = means/language (in Russian)
patternRecognition.answer: First = agent (by Pushkin); second = means/language (in Russian)
patternRecognition.explanation: Instrumental has multiple roles: Пушкиным = agent (by whom). На русском языке = means/language.

blanks: Двери _____ в восемь утра. (The doors open at 8 AM.) - habitual
Все вопросы _____. (All questions have been answered.) - result
explanations: Открываются: -ся passive. The doors open regularly.
Решены: short participle (plural). All questions ARE resolved.
